prompt:
Subject: delete, target meaning "削除".

Composition: An adult removes an unwanted photo tile from a computer's unlettered picture grid by dragging it into a small trash receptacle at the screen edge.

Style: Use references/invidious.png for style only: thick rounded dark-brown outlines, simplified rounded 2D shapes, restrained cartoon shading.

Framing: One compact composition filling 80–90% of the square; keep all subjects complete. No decorative frame, pedestal, or floating ornaments.

Output: 512×512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background and gaps. No text, letters, numerals, speech bubbles, labels, branding, or watermark.
Style reference invidious.png only: rounded friendly 2D cartoon, thick dark-brown outlines, flat colors, restrained shading. An adult removes an unwanted photo tile from an unlettered computer picture grid by dragging it into a small trash bin.
en: The user deletes an unwanted photo from the computer.
ja: 利用者が不要な写真をコンピューターから削除しています。
